column1: # Messages that tests/wireshark.rs has tshark dissect and compares with what the crate reads of them, field by
# field (compare.py, along mapping.tsv; known.tsv explains each difference). One message a row, by tabs: the
# system, where it comes from and what it shows, its octets. Each comes from a lab capture of a core or a
# RAN simulator, a fixture of the crate or a test of the crate; there is one of each shape of message that
# both read alike, some of each difference that known.tsv explains, and messages written from the clauses for
# the components that no capture has (packet filters, QoS flow parameters, EPS QoS bit rates, containers of
# protocol configuration options). None holds a key.
